in_sanskrit.name: इच्छा
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The root of the word Ichha is the Sanskrit word 'icch' which means 'to desire' or 'to wish'. The suffix '-a' is added to make it a feminine noun. So, Ichha means the one who has a strong desire or the one who has a strong intent.

in_hindi.name: ईच्छा
in_hindi.long_meaning: The name Ichha is pronounced as 'ईच्छा' (īcchā) in Hindi. It retains the same meaning as in Sanskrit, i.e., desire, wish, or intent.

in_tamil.name: இச்சை
in_tamil.long_meaning: In Tamil, the name Ichha is pronounced as 'இச்சை' (Iccai). It has the same meaning as in Sanskrit and Hindi, i.e., desire, wish, or intent.

in_telugu.name: ఇచ్చా
in_telugu.long_meaning: In Telugu, the name Ichha is pronounced as 'ఇచ్చా' (icchā). It has the same meaning as in Sanskrit, Hindi, and Tamil, i.e., desire, wish, or intent.

in_marathi.name: Ichha
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ichha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The fervent desire, the deepest wish of the heart.

in_bengali.name: Ichha
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Desire, Wish
in_bengali.long_meaning: Ichha একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। The fervent desire, the deepest wish of the heart.
